App details

Mini Games

Play eleven classic puzzles and small games offline in one app.

Coming soonIn developmentAndroid

What it’s for

Eleven offline games in one app, from linking number tiles in 2248 to taking turns at Nine Men’s Morris on a shared device.

Main features

  • 2248, Sudoku, Minesweeper, Snake, Reversi.
  • 15 Puzzle, Gomoku, Nine Men’s Morris, Solitaire · Klondike.
  • Tic-tac-toe, Block Puzzle.
  • Resume saved games, view local results and control sound and vibration separately.

Features in detail

Eleven games and their rules

2248

Drag a chain across the board of 5 columns and 8 rows. Tiles can touch in any of the eight directions, including diagonally. The first two must match. Each next tile must equal or double the previous one. Use each cell once and backtrack to remove the last tile if needed. Release to merge a valid chain of two or more tiles into the smallest power of two at least as large as their sum. For example, 2 + 2 + 4 → 8. The new tile forms in the last selected cell and adds its value to your score. The other selected tiles disappear, the remaining tiles fall and new ones enter from above. Keep playing while there is an adjacent pair of equal tiles. Your score, best score and largest tile are stored on your device.

Sudoku

Fill 9×9 with 1–9 once per row, column and 3×3 region. Choose Easy, Medium, Hard or Expert, enter numbers or pencil candidates and use optional hints/error counting. Direct duplicates are marked. Completion shows time, difficulty and hint use, with best time by difficulty; no fixed three-error loss is required.

Minesweeper

Choose 9×9 with 10 mines, 16×16 with 40, 30×16 with 99, or a custom board. Tap a covered cell to reveal it. Press and hold to place or remove a flag. The first reveal is safe. Numbers count nearby mines and empty areas open together. Pinch to zoom, pan to see other cells and open the overview to navigate large boards. Reveal every safe cell to win. Best times are kept locally by board profile.

Snake

Pick a starting speed of Slow, Normal or Fast. Steer with the on-screen joystick or swipe across the board. Eat food to grow, score and speed up. A wall or your own body ends the run. You can pause, and movement stops when the app goes into the background. Best scores are stored locally by speed.

Reversi

On 8×8, place a disc where it brackets opponent discs with your own, flipping all valid horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines. No legal move means a pass; when neither can move or the board fills, more discs wins. Play a local partner or an Easy/Medium/Hard computer opponent.

15 Puzzle

Slide a tile adjacent to the empty cell on a 4×4 board to restore numbers 1–15 in order, with the empty space last. New boards are solvable. Time and move count show your result, with best time and fewest moves kept locally.

Gomoku

Take turns placing stones on 15×15, black first. Five or more of your stones in a continuous horizontal, vertical or diagonal line wins; a full board without a winner draws. This is freestyle Gomoku. Choose a local partner or an Easy/Medium/Hard computer opponent.

Nine Men’s Morris

Place nine pieces each on the 24-point board. Then move to neighbouring empty points by dragging a piece or tapping it and its destination. Form a line of three to remove an opposing piece. Pieces in a mill are protected unless all the opponent’s pieces are in mills. With three left, move to any empty point. A player with fewer than three pieces or no legal move loses. Play on one device with a partner or against a computer at three difficulty levels.

Solitaire · Klondike

Choose to draw one or three cards at a time, with unlimited passes through the stock. Build seven columns in descending order and alternating colours. Move face-up sequences by dragging or by tapping a source and destination. Kings can start empty columns. Build four foundations from ace to king by suit. Undo recent moves or ask for a hint. Finish appears when the stock and waste are empty, all remaining cards are face up and the app can legally move them all to the foundations.

Tic-tac-toe

Place X and O alternately on 3×3, X first. Three of your marks in a row, column or diagonal wins; a full board without that draws. Play a local partner or Easy, Medium or Hard computer difficulty; Hard uses optimal play.

Block Puzzle

Place the three offered shapes in any order on an 8×8 board. Drag a shape from the tray, or tap the shape and then a board cell. Use the shapes in the orientations shown. Full rows and columns clear together. Consecutive clearing moves build a combo, and clearing the entire board earns a Perfect Clear bonus. The game ends when none of the remaining shapes fits. Your high score stays on the device.

Saved games, records and settings

Start a game or resume a saved session on your device. The collection keeps records and statistics suited to each game, such as best times, scores or win counts. You can reset selected statistics after confirming. Each game has its own offline sound effects and vibration feedback. The two settings can be switched independently.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All game modes are free. A banner may appear where the applicable advertising rules and your choices allow it. An optional one-time Google Play purchase removes banners. There are no subscriptions, rewarded ads or full-screen ads. Google Play shows the local price and handles purchase restoration.

Availability

Google Play is reviewing the closed test release. A public download is not available yet.
